why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open civitas.mainnet.romeprotocol.xyz/points and paste an EVM or Solana address, or connect a wallet. Up to 20 wallets can be combined.
Practise free on Hadrian, the testnet, with test USDC from Circle's faucet, bridged in. It doesn't add to mainnet Laurels.
Add Rubicon to MetaMask by hand: chain ID 7531, RPC https://rubicon.mainnet.romeprotocol.xyz/, symbol USDC. Rome warns: "Every transaction on Rubicon spends real USDC."

Fund it with the mainnet Rome Bridge : USDC over CCTP from Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Monad or OP, or SOL and USDC from a Solana wallet. "There is no faucet." The transfer itself counts.

Use Portus : "Lend USDC in a Kamino market you choose and withdraw to the same wallet." Warning Portus puts your USDC into a lending market on Solana, where a contract bug or market stress can cost you part of it. Lend only what you can afford to lose.
If you build or promote, sign in to Arena with a wallet or email and pick a role. Ambassador posts on X must carry your Arena code. This route is free.

Treat the Imperia NFT as optional: "Holding a Rome NFT does not create a right to Laurels, a bonus, a grant or a distribution." If you buy, use the link on rome.builders/imperia , because Rome says "we never DM links".
costs: Looking up Laurels and joining Arena are free. Everything counted on mainnet costs gas in real USDC, at a price the docs put at roughly ten times Hadrian's. They advise: "Fund at least 0.5 USDC of gas; 1 USDC leaves comfortable headroom." For builders, a first contract deploy "costs about 1.5 USDC at that price". Bridging in also costs gas on the source chain, and Rome publishes no bridge fee. Imp
risks: Nothing is owed: "Laurels give you no right to tokens, payment, a grant or any other benefit." "Rome alone decides whether to make a distribution, who is eligible, the amount and the conditions." KYC: "Identity verification will be required at claim." Rome hasn't named the provider.
